name: assembl-core
description: Core plugin — mandatory baseline for every assembl deployment. Privacy Act 2020 (incl. IPP 3A), tikanga compliance, Consumer Guarantees Act quick reference, NZBN lookup utility. Registers core MCP connectors: NZBN and Companies Office (live), plus stubs for IRD, NZ Customs Tariff, MFAT Sanctions, LBP register.
